episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: A dark event rocks a remote Arctic town in this unmissable original thriller. An all-star cast includes Christopher Eccleston and The Killing's Sofie Grabol.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: A dark event rocks a remote Arctic town in this unmissable original thriller. An all-star cast includes Christopher Eccleston and The Killing's Sofie Grabol.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: As the chilling thriller continues, Sheriff Anderssen and the police close in on their murder suspect, while DCI Morton follows a different line of enquiry.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Dan and Frank go in search of a suspect; however, Dan's feelings for Elena are threatening to overwhelm him. Morton, meanwhile, uncovers a new piece of evidence.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Following Dan's loss of control, Morton takes over the murder investigation. Elsewhere, Elena's mysterious past is about to catch up with her.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Shock waves reverberate around Fortitude as the killer is revealed, while Morton tunes his attention to the death of a scientist on the island months earlier.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: While Morton uncovers new information about the death of Billy Pettigrew, Hildur makes a heart-breaking discovery. Another gruesome event occurs in Fortitude.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Panic sweeps through Fortitude as news of the second attack spreads. Dan and Morton must work together while Frank hopes the latest events will exonerate Liam.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: While Frank takes the law into his own hands, DCI Morton closes in on the truth about Pettigrew's death. Vincent and Natalie also make a discovery.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: DCI Morton pursues Henry Tyson into the Arctic wilderness in search of the truth, while worrying test results force Governor Odegard to take drastic action.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: In the penultimate episode, the truth about Billy Pettigrew is revealed. In the lab, Natalie and Vincent probe the cause of the disturbing events in Fortitude.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: The chilling thriller concludes with a dramatic and emotional finale. Vincent faces a life-threatening situation, while Dan must make a devastating decision.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: As the remote Arctic town struggles with government cuts and a missing sheriff, a chilling discovery proves that the horror isn't over for the locals.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Governor Odegard is presented with devastating news as Sheriff Dan struggles for his life, and a new threat makes its presence known.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Natalie and Vincent head out into the wilderness and the police track down their suspect, but a dark turn of events leads them to question everything.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Eric struggles to keep control as the body count increases. Meanwhile, Natalie and Vincent's field trip descends into chaos.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: A disturbing challenge is issued. Michael finds a glimmer of hope for Freya, while Vincent's trust in Natalie is shattered.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Dr. Khatri attempts to cover her tracks when Michael presents the scientists with a miracle. Dan and Elena relive their trauma.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Michael finds something unexpected on the tundra, and Dan is confronted with what he is becoming, just as a heartbreaking discovery changes the town forever.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: As the town attempts to come to terms with the recent tragedy, Petra and Ingrid seek the truth. Meanwhile, Dr Khatri moves a step closer to achieving her goal.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Dan faces his toughest battle yet as someone makes the ultimate sacrifice for the greater good, while Michael and Ingrid venture out in search of justice.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: The people of Fortitude take matters into their own hands. Dan seeks his own vengeance, but is there still a demon among the herd?

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: New visitors arrive in Fortitude, and new horrors are unearthed.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Michael thinks he has a shot at redemption when he meets Elsa, but gets caught up in her deadly plan for survival.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Michael hunts for the place he was held captive, and makes a shocking discovery. Annie Burgess arrives in Fortitude looking for answers.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Michael sacrifices everything for a possible future with Elsa. As his violent deeds catch up with him, Dan realises he will never leave Fortitude.
